messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] Starting weighted traffic shift for service=inference-api version=v2 in prod. Change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 PT. Plan: 0 -> 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 8m steady at each step. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 1.2% or p95_latency > 900ms. Rolling out scoped by region by default. /deploy id=infra/rdw-inference v=2026.03.20

sarah: @deploy-bot can we scope the canary to us-west1 only for the first two steps? want to limit blast radius.

deploy-bot: Affirmative. Running scoped shift. Command: `rtrctl shift --service inference-api --from v1 --to v2 --weight 5 --region us-west1` :rocket:

raj: also adding an internal smoke route for beta testers. Add this header match so internal traffic hits v2:
```
routes:
  - match: header(x-internal-beta) == "true"
    weight: 100
    version: v2
```
This lets us exercise v2 without impacting normal users.

lee: SRE checklist: tracing enabled, kv-cache warm, model cold-start observed. Please pin v1 in LB config so rollback is clean (`pin_version: v1`).

emily: quick product check — does this touch embeddings endpoints or only text-gen? need to flag customers if embeddings perf changes.

raj: embeddings untouched. rollout is only for text-gen path (inference-api). I'll post a note in #docs.

monitor-bot: watch created: inference-api:v2-canary-watch. Alerts: error_rate > 1.2% (5m), p95_latency > 900ms (5m), cpu_util > 85% (2m). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/inference/rollouts?id=inference-api

deploy-bot: canary at 5% (us-west1) applied. holding 8m before next step. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lee: seeing p95 move from ~420ms -> ~720ms on canary hosts but still under threshold. watching.

sarah: watch errors especially 429/503. if >0.7% for those codes, call rollback.

monitor-bot: update (+4m): p95 840ms, errors 0.45% (mostly 429 retryable). traces logged under trace id 0x9b3f.

raj: 429s look like backpressure from request queue. Can we temporarily add worker capacity on canary pods? `kubectl scale --replicas=3 rs/inference-canary`

deploy-bot: executing scale for canary pool now.

monitor-bot: scale succeeded. canary replicas=3. p95 trending down.

lee: p95 back to ~510ms, error_rate 0.3% — ok to go to 25% in us-west1.

sarah: proceed. keep global steps paused until we validate us-west1.

deploy-bot: shifting to 25% in us-west1. Command: `rtrctl shift --service inference-api --to v2 --weight 25 --region us-west1` :white_check_mark:

monitor-bot: (+6m after 25%): global p95 520ms, us-west1 p95 610ms, error_rate 0.6% (429s down to 0.4%). CPU on canary hosts 72%.

emily: product would like a short release-note blurb. Draft: "Text-generation service upgraded to v2; expect lower median latency on long prompts; staged rollout in progress. Contact support for regressions." ok?

sarah: fine by me.

deploy-bot: next step scheduled to 60% after 10m hold unless aborted. auto-rollback thresholds remain active.

monitor-bot: (+12m) ALERT: us-west1 p95 jumped to 1.12s and error_rate spiked to 1.6% (5m window). Triggering alert :warning:.

lee: that's above auto-rollback thresholds. Recommend immediate rollback to v1 and pin.

sarah: +1 rollback now. Keep v2 accessible only to internal beta and open a follow-up investigation.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Rolling back inference-api to v1 in us-west1 and applying `pin_version: v1` to LB. Running: `rtrctl shift --service inference-api --to v1 --weight 100 --region us-west1` then applying pin. :wrench:

monitor-bot: rollback executed. traffic returned to v1 in us-west1. p95 back to 430ms, error_rate 0.12%.

raj: creating temp feature branch for v2 perf fixes. Will add finer-grained telemetry around request queue and per-shard latencies.

emily: updating release notes to mention aborted rollout and rollback; cc-ing support & customer-success.

lee: opened incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/internal/incidents/2026-03-20-v2-canary. Added timeline, logs, and initial traces from canary hosts.

sarah: good catch. Next steps: sync with model + infra tomorrow to run smaller, more conservative canary with extra CPU headroom. I'll schedule change window and owners.

deploy-bot: marking rollout aborted and rollback completed. Change window closed for this rollout. :checkered_flag:

sarah: follow-up meeting 2026-03-20 10:30am PT. Bring traces, queue metrics, and canary logs. :thumbsup:
